versions.changelog: Fix HTML delivery guidance: use /tmp/openclaw trusted temp root, avoid plain /tmp/media/workspace paths, document current hostReadCapability failure modes.

Initial release of telegram-wim-wsl-file-delivery.

- Enables secure, policy-aware delivery of local files to OpenClaw chat channels, with emphasis on hosts using local/WSL setups.
- Adds confirmation and path validation steps prior to outbound sends.
- Details handling for trusted HTML delivery via `/tmp/openclaw` when host-read policy restricts workspace paths.
- Documents CLI-based fallback strategies and comprehensive error handling for common failures.
- Provides clear workflow guidance and troubleshooting tips for smooth file delivery.
